rules.new_licensee_rule: Initial cycle runs from licensure to the end of the birth month in the even/odd year matching the birth year; the same hour minimum applies to the initial cycle.
rules.carryover: Not allowed: hours above the minimum do not carry forward.
rules.alternatives: Written extension request for extenuating circumstances at least 7 days before the cycle ends.
rules.audit_note: Professional development portfolio kept by the licensee; random and designated audits - portfolio due within 60 days. Keep documentation for the current and previous cycle.
rules.accepted_credit_types: Fundamental (min 15 h): clinical seminars, webinars, symposiums, lectures, basic science college courses, infection control, Board-approved activities. Elective (max 10 h): conventions, volunteer work, professional reading/self-study, teaching/scholarly work, practice management, leadership.

topics.who: All licensees: an infection control course is mandatory each cycle (fundamental activity)
Consecutive, current CPR certified at renewal

rules.notes: License expires the last day of the birth month (even/odd year matching birth year). Must certify consecutive, current CPR at renewal.
